# Avarin (avarin.ai)

> Avarin is an AI agent platform for hotel groups that talks to guests during their stay, auto-responds to reviews in every language, and escalates problems to the right team. The in-stay agent is guest-facing over WhatsApp, while Sia is the manager-facing assistant for operational analysis and group briefings.

## Overview & Architecture
Avarin operates three primary jobs in hospitality operations:
1. In-Stay Guest Issue Resolution: An AI agent engages guests over WhatsApp, resolves inquiries from grounded hotel guides, and creates operational tickets with urgency and attached evidence when physical assistance is needed.
2. Automated Review Responses: Directly integrates with Google Business Profile to draft multilingual, empathetic responses in the hotel's authentic brand voice, supporting both auto-publish and approve-first workflows.
3. Group Portfolio Intelligence: Regional and corporate leaders use Sia and aggregated analytics to monitor operational exposure, review momentum, and response coverage across every property.

## Verified Production Integrations
- WhatsApp: Guest-facing messaging channel during the stay.
- Google Business Profile: Review monitoring and automated response publishing.

## Sia: Voice Agent for Managers
Sia is manager-facing and available through text and conversational voice. Managers can ask about hotel performance, investigate reviews and operational issues, compare authorized property or competitor data, and request permitted issue assignments, status updates, or property-information changes. Voice continues the selected Sia chat with live captions and a saved spoken transcript. Its tools and permissions match text Sia. Conversational voice is distinct from generated voice briefings.
